create_channel_ready_future: create a future that tracks when a gRPC channel becomes ready using channel_ready_future
cancel_channel_ready_future: cancel a channel ready future to unsubscribe from the gRPC channel connectivity updates
add_done_callback_to_future: add a done callback function to the channel ready future for notification on completion
check_channel_future_status: check if the channel ready future is done, running, or cancelled using status methods
wait_for_channel_result: wait for the channel ready future result with an optional timeout value
